budget_items.topic: Artificial turf field bond and revolving fund
budget_items.what_was_recorded: The school committed $40,000 and the Lunenburg Bengals $7,500 toward the twelve-year turf field bond, with those fees deposited into the revolving fund.
budget_items.quote: there is a twelve year bond on the turf field and the school has committed $40,000.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Current debt service on the turf field is about $75,000 a year for twelve years.
budget_items.quote: the debt service payments we have right now are right around $75,000 annually for twelve years.

budget_items.topic: Rental and lease receipts (MGL c. 40, s. 3)
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Anything over $10,000 in rental or lease receipts at year's end would revert to the general fund, but the fund never exceeds that amount.
budget_items.quote: ms. brochu stated anything over $10,000 at year's end would revert to the general fund

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The cell tower lease is a general fund receipt that could be used to offset the debt service.
budget_items.quote: the cell tower lease; this is a general fund receipt but it could be used to offset the debt service

budget_items.topic: Quarterly financial report, tax lien revenue
budget_items.what_was_recorded: The tax levy collection figure includes tax lien revenue.
budget_items.quote: this includes $151,425.98 in tax lien revenue

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Surpluses in liability insurance and workers compensation exist because rate increases came in below budget.
budget_items.quote: we have surpluses in both liability insurance and workers compensation due to lower than budgeted rate increases.

budget_items.topic: Wallis Park and Commonwealth Places grant
budget_items.what_was_recorded: A MassDevelopment Commonwealth Places grant could provide a matching grant if a crowdfunding goal is reached; no amount was given.
budget_items.quote: receive a matching grant amount from massdevelopment

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Selectman reached out about a citizen's petition to appropriate additional funds for Wallis Park; no amount was given.
budget_items.quote: citizen's petition to appropriate additional funds for wallis park
